statement: ∀ {m n : ℕ} (L : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin m), (toLin' L) v i = ∑ j, L i j * v j
script:
# name: la-matrix-map-apply-test
# technique: test a claim no recipe certifies, at instances the kernel checks by computation (test_fallback)
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearMaps.matrix_map_apply file "la-matrix-map-apply-test.sage"
# description: L(v)^i = L^i_j v^j for explicit matrices and vectors (1 × 1 zero, 2 × 3, 2 × 2), by evaluation.
SEED = 0  # EDIT: the sampler's seed, kept in the test record
PROOF = 'simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ]'  # EDIT: the tactic block proving the claim at one instance
CASES = [  # EDIT: the instances as ([values as Lean text], edge?[, proof]) tuples
    (['1', '1', '!![0]', '![3]', '0'], True),
    (['2', '3', '!![1, 2, 3; 4, 5, 6]', '![1, 0, -1]', '1'], False),
    (['2', '2', '!![2, -1; 0, 0]', '![1 / 2, 1]', '0'], False),
]
cases = CASES
instances = [kernel_instance(*c[0], proof=c[2] if len(c) > 2 else PROOF, edge=c[1]) for c in cases]

goal.text: (toLin' L) v i = ∑ j, L i j * v j
goal.rhs: ∑ j, L i j * v j

atoms: ∑ j, L i j * v j
